evidence.note: Hand reaches and grips the small entry closet door handle; door is still closed.
Closet door is opening and the closet contents become visible.
Hand grips the open closet door to close it.
Closet door is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Small entry closet door beside the apartment entrance

evidence.note: Hand reaches the over-range microwave handle.
Microwave door is swinging open.
Microwave remains fully open immediately before closing.
Hand pushes the microwave door toward the closed position.
Microwave door is fully closed.
Hand pulls the oven handle and the door begins moving downward.
Oven door is open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Oven door is still partly open during the closing action.
Hand finishes lifting the oven door shut.
Hand approaches the dishwasher handle while its door is closed.
Dishwasher door is open, exposing the racks.
Dishwasher remains open shortly before closure.
Hand lifts the dishwasher door toward closed.
Dishwasher is fully closed.
Hand grips the right door of the upper cabinet over the sink.
Cabinet doors are opening and shelves become visible.
Both cabinet doors remain open.
Hand pushes the cabinet doors closed.
Cabinet is fully closed.

events.object_description: Double-door upper cabinet above the sink

evidence.note: Hand grips the upper drawer front beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is pulled open and its contents are visible.
Drawer remains fully extended.
Drawer is closed flush with the cabinetry.

events.object_description: Upper kitchen drawer immediately left of the refrigerator

evidence.note: Hand grips the upper refrigerator-compartment handle.
Upper refrigerator door is open and the interior light is on.
Refrigerator compartment remains open.
Hand pushes the upper refrigerator door closed.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
Hand grips the lower freezer handle.
Lower freezer door is opening and the freezer interior appears.
Freezer door remains open.
Hand begins pushing the lower freezer door closed.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Laundry closet door is closed.
Door has opened, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Laundry closet remains open with the appliances visible.
Hand pulls the laundry closet door toward closed.
Laundry closet door is fully closed.

events.object_description: Laundry closet door concealing the stacked washer and dryer

notes: Detected nine consecutive localized open-close interaction episodes. Frame estimates are midpoints of the visible state-changing actions; 'on' denotes open and 'off' denotes closed.
scene_description: A person moves through a studio apartment and sequentially opens and closes an entry closet, microwave, oven, dishwasher, upper cabinet, drawer, refrigerator compartment, freezer compartment, and laundry closet.
